raw_quote: Union Personal Loan scheme designed for salaried individuals to meet genuine personal expenses.
Unsecured retail personal loan.
Clean collateral-free personal loan facility.
Applicant must be an Indian Resident Citizen.
Minimum applicant age is 18 years.
Maximum age is 1 year prior to superannuation / retirement (typically 59 to 60 years).
Confirmed or permanent employees of Central/State Govt, PSUs, reputed private institutions.
Minimum continuous service of 1 year as a confirmed employee.
Minimum bureau score benchmark of 680 (qualifies for EBLR + 2.35% = 10.60%).
Prime score 800+ qualifies for EBLR + 1.05% (effective starting rate 9.30% p.a.).
CIBIL 750 to 799: EBLR + 1.35% (effective rate 9.60% p.a.).
CIBIL 700 to 749: EBLR + 1.85% (effective rate 10.10% p.a.).
Maximum quantum for Scheme A (corporate tie-up) is Rs. 15.00 Lakhs.
Maximum quantum for Scheme B (non tie-up / open market) is Rs. 5.00 Lakhs.
Minimum sanctionable ticket size: Rs. 25,000.
Permissible deductions / FOIR capped at 50% of net monthly income (up to 60% for gross monthly income > Rs 75,000).
Minimum net take home salary after proposed EMI must be at least Rs. 12,000/month.

how_derived: Standard retail public bank multiplier: capped at 15x net monthly income.
raw_quote: Maximum loan quantum capped at 15 times net monthly salary.
Minimum repayment period: 12 months.
Maximum repayment tenure: 60 months (5 years).
Starting floating rate for CIBIL 800+ is 9.30% p.a. (EBLR + 1.05%).
Upper band ceiling rate for non-prime/unrated accounts up to 14.50% p.a.
Penal interest charged at 2% p.a. over applicable rate on overdue amounts.
Processing fee: 0.50% to 1.00% (min Rs. 500, max Rs. 7,500 + GST).
Zero / NIL prepayment and foreclosure penalties for individual floating-rate borrowers.
Sanction is at bank's sole discretion subject to satisfactory credit checks and verification.
